resources.string: Some saved data couldn\'t be read — restore from a snapshot or dismiss.
Set aside: %1$s. Nocturne kept the unreadable copies and is using defaults in their place. Dismissing this notice doesn\'t make an unknown slot safe to overwrite.
Nocturne couldn\'t finish writing a restore. Until it can, changes to profiles, settings, history and saved originals aren\'t saved.
Free some storage space, then reopen Nocturne. This notice stays until the restore is finished.
The saved originals of some BedJet slots couldn\'t be read. Slots with no saved original won\'t be written until you accept that those originals are lost.
Accept that these originals are lost?

The saved originals of some BedJet slots can\'t be recovered. If you accept, Nocturne can write those slots again. Whatever a slot holds at that point is saved as its original and marked as uncertain, because it may be one of Nocturne\'s own programmes. Every original saved from now on is marked uncertain too.
Your BedJet hasn\'t confirmed “%1$s” on slot %2$d. Check the BedJet, then mark it as checked.
While a confirmed night runs, a silent notification shows its wake time with an End button.

A file to help work out a problem: app version, phone model, connection state, your settings (including the chosen BedJet\'s address), the night in progress and the last 50 events and notifications. Your update token is never included. Nothing is sent anywhere; you choose where the file is saved.
Saved for next night. Tonight\'s night keeps the settings it started with.
Your saved edits to %1$s start with the next night. Tonight keeps the settings it started with.
Requested wake %1$s — waiting for your BedJet to confirm.
A new wake time is waiting for your BedJet to confirm.
Tonight only: it lapses at %1$s on %2$s. After that your profile and alarm decide the wake time again.
Try Nocturne with a simulated BedJet. It never sends anything to a real one, and you can choose a real BedJet later.

Some Samsung phones put apps to sleep to save battery, even with unrestricted battery use. If overnight changes don\'t reach your BedJet, open Settings › Battery › Background usage limits and check that Nocturne isn\'t listed under Sleeping apps or Deep sleeping apps; you can add it to Never sleeping apps. Menu names vary between One UI versions, and Nocturne can\'t check these settings for you.
